paite: Jeremiah kiang ah TOUPA a kipan thu ahong tung a;
heading: Amite Kiang A TOUPA Thuchiamte
english: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

paite: TOUPA Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Na kiang a thu ka gen tengteng laibu ah gelh in," chi in.
english: Thus speaks Yahweh, the God of Israel, saying, Write all the words that I have spoken to you in a book.

paite: Ngai in, Israel leh Judah, ka mite omdan ka kikhelsakna ding nite ahong tung lellel hi; gam, apipute uh kiang a ka piak ah ka pikik nawn ding a, aluahta ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, chi in TOUPA'N achi.
english: For, behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that I will turn again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, says Yahweh; and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.

paite: Huan Judah leh Israel tungtang thu a TOUPA thugen hiaite ahi:
english: These are the words that Yahweh spoke concerning Israel and concerning Judah.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Lauhthawnna husa ka za uh, muanna hilou, launa kikou husa.
english: For thus says Yahweh: We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.

paite: Dong vialvial unla, en vialvial dih ua, pasal in nau avei thei hia? Bangziak a numei nauvei bang zen a, pasalte'n atai uh adep chiat ua, amelte uh ahong molh khit?
english: Ask now, and see whether a man does travail with child: why do I see every man with his hands on his waist, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?

paite: Maizen aw! Huai ni thupi hina mai e, akibatpih mahmah a-om kei, Jakob mangbat ni ahi mah ngut hi, himahleh hotkhiak in a-om ding.
english: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.

paite: Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, ahakkol puak ka hihtan ding a, akhau leng ka kitatsak ding; pau tuam mite'n amah nasempa ding in azang ngei nawn kei ding uh.
english: It shall come to pass in that day, says Yahweh of Armies, that I will break his yoke from off your neck, and will burst your bonds; and strangers shall no more make him their bondservant;

paite: TOUPA a Pathian uh leh akumpipa uh hi ding a ka tunding ding David nna asem zaw ding uhi.
english: but they shall serve Yahweh their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up to them.

paite: Huaiziak in aw ka nasempa Jakob aw, lau het ke'n aw, Israel aw, lunglel het ke'n, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Ngai in, gamlapi a kipan in ka hong hunkhe ding a, asaltanna ua kipan na suante ngei, huan Jakob akik nawn ding a, kuamah in alausak ngei nawn kei ding uh.
english: Therefore don’t you be afraid, O Jacob my servant, says Yahweh; neither be dismayed, Israel: for, behold, I will save you from afar, and your seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be quiet and at ease, and none shall make him afraid.

paite: Nang hon hun ding in na kiang ah ka om gige ngal a, ka hon dalhsakna nam tengteng, ka beisak ding a, nang bel beisak lou in; ahun lel in ka hon gawt ding a, gawt louh in na pawt het kei ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: For I am with you, says Yahweh, to save you: for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have scattered you, but I will not make a full end of you; but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi ngal a, na liamna hihdam theih ahi kei a, na meima athupi hi.
english: For thus says Yahweh, Your hurt is incurable, and your wound grievous.

paite: Nang hon panpih ding a-om kei ua, na damna ding damdawi a-om sam kei hi.
english: There is none to plead your cause, that you may be bound up: you have no healing medicines.

paite: Nang hon itte'n ahon mangngilhta ua, hon limsakta kei uh; melma liamna in ka hon liamsak a, dawm lou in ka hon gawt hi, na thulimlouhna athupi a, na thilhih giloute apun ziak in.
english: All your lovers have forgotten you; they don’t seek you: for I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins were increased.

paite: Bangziak a na liam ziak a kap na hia? Na liamna hihdam theih ahi kei, na thulimlouhna athupi a, na thilhihkhelhte apun ziak in, hiai thilte na tung a hih ka hi.
english: Why do you cry for your hurt? Your pain is incurable: for the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins were increased, I have done these things to you.

paite: Himahleh nang hon negaite, nekgaih in a-om ding ua, na melmate michih, sal dia pi in a-om ding uh, nang hon lokte loh in a-om ding ua, gallak a hon late gallak in ka la ding hi.
english: Therefore all those who devour you shall be devoured; and all your adversaries, everyone of them, shall go into captivity; and those who despoil you shall be a spoil, and all who prey on you will I give for a prey.

paite: Ka hon damsak nawn ding a, na liamnate ka hihdam ding; TOUPA thupawt in achi; delhkhiak, ahon chi ua, kuamah limsak louh Zion ahi, ahon chih ziak un.
english: For I will restore health to you, and I will heal you of your wounds, says Yahweh; because they have called you an outcast, saying, It is Zion, whom no man seeks after.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Ngai in, Jakob puanin saltangte ka lehhei ding a, atenna munte ka zahngaihsak ding a, a-omna mual ngei ah akhopi lam ahi ding a, akumpipa' inn a-omdan ngei in adingh nawn ding.
english: Thus says Yahweh: Behold, I will turn again the captivity of Jacob’s tents, and have compassion on his dwelling places; and the city shall be built on its own hill, and the palace shall be inhabited in its own way.

paite: Kipahthu Genna leh nopsakna husa, huaite a pan ahong pawtkhe ding a, Mite ka pungsak ding a, atawm kei ding uh, amau ka hih thupi ding a, aneu kei ding uh.
english: Out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of those who make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.

paite: Atate uh leng nidanglai bang in a-om ding ua, ka ma ah a-omkhopna uh akip ding a; amaute nuaisiah mite peuhmah ka gawt ding hi.
english: Their children also shall be as before, and their congregation shall be established before me; and I will punish all who oppress them.

paite: Aheutupa uh amau mi mah ahi ding a, avaihawmpa uh amau lak a hong pawt mah ahi ding; ahon naih ding a, amah ka bawl dia, ama'n ahon naih ding; kua ahia amah thu a hon naih ngam ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Their prince shall be of themselves, and their ruler shall proceed from their midst; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach to me: for who is he who has had boldness to approach to me? says Yahweh.

paite: Huan ka mite na hi ding ua, kei na Pathian uh ka hi ding."
english: You shall be my people, and I will be your God.

paite: Ngai un, TOUPA huihpi, ahehna huihpi hat mahmah apawtkheta a; migiloute lu anuai ek ding hi.
english: Behold, the storm of Yahweh, his wrath, has gone forth, a sweeping storm: it shall burst on the head of the wicked.

paite: Alungtang tupnate tangtun a ahih khit masiah, TOUPA hehna lauhuai mahmah akikhel kei ding; ni nanungte ah na hon theisiam ding uhi.
english: The fierce anger of Yahweh will not return, until he has executed, and until he has performed the intentions of his heart. In the latter days you will understand it.
